svg.aria-label: Architecture: phone, Node server and cloud APIs. Microphone audio goes straight to AssemblyAI streaming. Camera clips go through the server to Gemini. Text goes through the server to AssemblyAI text-to-speech.
svg.title: Architecture: phone, Node server and cloud APIs. Microphone audio goes straight to AssemblyAI streaming. Camera clips go through the server to Gemini. Text goes through the server to AssemblyAI text-to-speech.
svg.text: The phone hears, watches and speaks. The server holds the keys and checks every line.
AudioWorklet feeds one always-on speech socket.
"Hey Iris", or a clear command with no wake word.
Routes to look, medicine, guide or stop.
~3 s rolling frame buffer, gyro heading, tilt.
PathGuard depth runs here, on the device.
Only calls out when you moved or ~10 s passed.
Carries memory, the goal and the active hazard.
Urgent lines cut in. Stale lines are dropped.
Audio goes straight to it over a secure socket.
read, scenery, route, medicine labels, room scan
plus one arrival check per trip
Sees a 3-frame clip plus notes on the room.
Answers in JSON, about 1 s, no thinking.
